# Crosswalk coverage at CodeMeta 3.1

<!-- Generated by `codemeta-drift hub coverage examples/mapping-3.1.json --codemeta <checkout>`; edit the curated rows, not this file. -->

How CodeMeta's 3.1 crosswalks map 34 terms in 45 formats, read from the reviewed [mapping export](mapping-export.md). `crossref`, `arxiv`, `cff-preferred`, `pep621`, `composer`, `typst`, `quarto`, `ris`, `endnote`, `ro-crate`, `croissant` have no CodeMeta crosswalk, so each of their paths is added here. The [web page](https://simonvanlierde.com/codemeta-drift/) also checks CodeMeta's main branch against the newest tag each week.

| Mark | Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ✓ | as-is | CodeMeta's crosswalk cell is the path |
| ⊂ | scope | the crosswalk cell is right by CodeMeta's definition, but codemeta-drift reads the term more narrowly (identifier as the software's DOI, a person's @id as their ORCID, publisher as its name, swhid as a term of its own) or also reads another field, such as a fallback or a newer one; the reviewed mapping gives the path, or says the format has none |
| ≈ | notation | the crosswalk cell names the right field, but in a form a tool can't use as a path, such as another case, no prefix or XPath; the reviewed mapping gives the path |
| ✎ | corrected | the crosswalk cell is wrong, ambiguous or prose; the reviewed mapping gives the path |
| + | added | the reviewed mapping gives a path where no upstream cell supplies one |
| – | no field | the review found no usable path for this term |
| ∅ | no term | CodeMeta has no property for this term; the reviewed mapping adds the path |

## Curated cells

### cff-1.2.0

- `author.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `person.orcid / identifiers / doi` → `authors[].orcid`. The cell lists person.orcid / identifiers / doi; a person's ORCID is orcid.
- `contributor` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `contributor.givenName` (no field): crosswalk cell `person.given-names` → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `contributor.familyName` (no field): crosswalk cell `person.family-names` → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `contributor.@id` (no field): crosswalk cell `person.orcid / identifiers / doi` → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `license` (notation): crosswalk cell `license / license-url` → `license | license-url`. The cell lists license / license-url; license holds SPDX ids, and license-url the URL of a licence that is not on the SPDX list (CFF 1.2.0 schema), so the path falls back to it.
- `identifier` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identifiers / person.orcid / doi` → `doi | identifiers[type=doi].value`. The cell lists identifiers / person.orcid / doi; the software DOI is doi, or the doi entry of identifiers.
- `swhid` (scope): crosswalk cell `identifiers / person.orcid / doi` → `identifiers[type=swh].value`. The cell lists identifiers / person.orcid / doi; a SWHID is the swh entry of identifiers.
- `publisher` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty; CFF has publisher only inside references[] and preferred-citation, which describe other works.
- `resourceType` (no term): no crosswalk cell → `type`. CodeMeta has no term for the resource type; CFF states its resource type in the top-level type key.
- `preferredCitation` (added): no crosswalk cell → `preferred-citation`. CFF 1.2.0 stores the separate preferred reference in preferred-citation.

- `resourceType` (no term): no crosswalk cell → `type`. Crossref REST gives its content type, such as journal-article.

- `pagination` (added): no crosswalk cell → `page | article-number`. Crossref REST gives pages in page, with an article number for some unpaginated articles.

### datacite

- `name` (notation): crosswalk cell `title` → `titles[].title`. The cell says title, the XML element; in the REST JSON titles is a list of objects with a title key.
- `author.@id` (notation): crosswalk cell `nameIdentifier` → `creators[].nameIdentifiers[nameIdentifierScheme=ORCID].nameIdentifier`. The cell says nameIdentifier, the XML element; in the REST JSON identifiers sit in nameIdentifiers, each with a nameIdentifierScheme (ORCID, ISNI or ROR, DataCite 4.6 property 2.4), and the ORCID is the one whose scheme is ORCID.
- `contributor` (notation): crosswalk cell `contributor` → `contributors[]`. The cell says contributor, the XML element; the REST JSON key is contributors, a list of objects that each carry a contributorType.
- `contributor.@id` (notation): crosswalk cell `nameIdentifier` → `contributors[].nameIdentifiers[nameIdentifierScheme=ORCID].nameIdentifier`. The cell says nameIdentifier, the XML element; in the REST JSON identifiers sit in nameIdentifiers, each with a nameIdentifierScheme (ORCID, ISNI or ROR, DataCite 4.6 property 7.4), and the ORCID is the one whose scheme is ORCID.
- `license` (corrected): crosswalk cell `rights` → `rightsList[].rightsUri`. The cell says rights, the free-text statement; bolognese's CodeMeta writer and commonmeta take the licence from rightsUri.
- `identifier` (notation): crosswalk cell `identifier` → `doi`. The cell says identifier, the XML element; the REST JSON holds the DOI in doi (bare, such as 10.5281/zenodo.7635478), and identifiers is the list of alternate identifiers.
- `swhid` (scope): crosswalk cell `identifier` → `relatedIdentifiers[relatedIdentifierType=SWHID].relatedIdentifier`. The cell says identifier, the element that holds the DOI; DataCite 4.7 added SWHID as a relatedIdentifierType, so a SWHID is a related identifier.
- `codeRepository` (added): no crosswalk cell → `relatedIdentifiers[relationType=IsSupplementTo].relatedIdentifier | url`. No cell; DataCite has no repository property. Zenodo records the repository as a related identifier with relationType IsSupplementTo; bolognese's CodeMeta writer uses url, which holds the repository for DOIs registered from codemeta.json.
- `description` (notation): crosswalk cell `description` → `descriptions[descriptionType=Abstract].description`. The cell says description, the XML element; in the REST JSON descriptions is a list, and the summary is the one with descriptionType Abstract. bolognese's CodeMeta writer takes the first description, which is the Abstract in most records.
- `keywords` (notation): crosswalk cell `subject` → `subjects[].subject`. The cell says subject, the XML element; in the REST JSON subjects is a list of objects with a subject key.
- `datePublished` (scope): crosswalk cell `publicationYear` → `dates[dateType=Issued].date | publicationYear`. The cell says publicationYear, 'The year when the data was or will be made publicly available' (DataCite 4.6, property 5), which is right but only a year; a date of dateType Issued, 'The date that the resource is published or distributed' (appendix 1), gives the day, so the path reads it first, as bolognese's writers do.
- `publisher` (notation): crosswalk cell `publisher` → `publisher.name | publisher`. The cell says publisher, the XML element; the REST API returns the name as a string by default, and an object with a name key (since schema 4.5) only when the request has publisher=true.
- `resourceType` (no term): no crosswalk cell → `types.resourceTypeGeneral`. DataCite requires types.resourceTypeGeneral; CodeMeta has no term for it.
- `author.name` (added): no crosswalk cell → `creators[].name`. The DataCite creator name holds the full personal or organizational name.
- `author.resourceType` (added): no crosswalk cell → `creators[].nameType`. DataCite distinguishes Personal and Organizational creators with nameType.
- `contributor.name` (added): no crosswalk cell → `contributors[].name`. The DataCite contributor name holds the full personal or organizational name.
- `contributor.resourceType` (added): no crosswalk cell → `contributors[].nameType`. DataCite distinguishes Personal and Organizational contributors with nameType.
- `url` (added): no crosswalk cell → `url`. DataCite REST gives the resulting landing page URL.
- `isVersionOf` (added): no crosswalk cell → `relatedIdentifiers[relationType=IsVersionOf].relatedIdentifier`. DataCite links the specific version to its resource through IsVersionOf.
- `hasVersion` (added): no crosswalk cell → `relatedIdentifiers[relationType=HasVersion].relatedIdentifier`. DataCite links the common resource to a specific version through HasVersion.

### spdx-2.3

- `name` (notation): crosswalk cell `PackageName` → `packages[].name`. The cell is the tag-value field PackageName; in the JSON serialisation the package's name is name inside an element of packages.
- `version` (notation): crosswalk cell `PackageVersion` → `packages[].versionInfo`. The cell is the tag-value field PackageVersion; the JSON key is versionInfo.
- `author` (notation): crosswalk cell `PackageOriginator` → `packages[].originator | packages[].supplier`. The cell is the tag-value field PackageOriginator; the JSON key is originator, one agent string. The spec fills originator only when it differs from the supplier, so supplier is the fallback.
- `author.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `packages[].originator | packages[].supplier`. No cell; originator and supplier keep the whole name in one string, with no given and family name apart.
- `author.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `packages[].originator | packages[].supplier`. No cell; originator and supplier keep the whole name in one string, with no given and family name apart.
- `author.@id` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; the agent syntax is a name and an optional email, with no place for an ORCID.
- `contributor` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; a package has only supplier and originator, and no contributor field.
- `contributor.givenName` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; a package has no contributor field.
- `contributor.familyName` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; a package has no contributor field.
- `contributor.@id` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; a package has no contributor field.
- `license` (corrected): crosswalk cell `PackageLicenseConcluded` → `packages[].licenseDeclared`. The cell is PackageLicenseConcluded, the licence the SPDX document's preparer concluded; the licence the package's authors declared is licenseDeclared, which is what CodeMeta's license means.
- `identifier` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; Annex F lists no DOI external reference type (only SECURITY, PACKAGE-MANAGER, PERSISTENT-ID swh and gitoid, and OTHER with a free idstring).
- `swhid` (added): no crosswalk cell → `packages[].externalRefs[referenceType=swh].referenceLocator`. No cell; Annex F.4.1 defines the external reference type swh in category PERSISTENT-ID, whose locator is a SWHID.
- `codeRepository` (corrected): crosswalk cell `PackageSourceInfo` → `packages[].downloadLocation`. The cell is PackageSourceInfo, which is free text about how the package was acquired; a repository is given in downloadLocation in the VCS form `git+https://host/path.git`.
- `description` (notation): crosswalk cell `PackageSummary / PackageDescription` → `packages[].description | packages[].summary`. The cell lists PackageSummary and PackageDescription; description is the detailed text and summary the short one, so the detailed text leads.
- `keywords` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; a package has no keywords field.
- `datePublished` (notation): crosswalk cell `ReleaseDate` → `packages[].releaseDate`. The cell is the tag-value field ReleaseDate; the JSON key is releaseDate.
- `publisher` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty; PackageSupplier is CodeMeta's provider (SPDX_2_3.csv), and the author rows already read it.
- `resourceType` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. CodeMeta has no term for the resource type; primaryPackagePurpose only subdivides software, so a consumer defaults to Software.

### codemeta-2

- `author.@id` (scope): crosswalk cell `identifier` → `author[].@id`. The cell says identifier, which is schema:identifier; the 2.0 example and the context put a person's ORCID in @id (the context also aliases id to @id).
- `contributor.@id` (scope): crosswalk cell `identifier` → `contributor[].@id`. The cell says identifier, which is schema:identifier; the 2.0 example and the context put a person's ORCID in @id (the context also aliases id to @id).
- `publisher` (scope): crosswalk cell `publisher` → `publisher.name | publisher`. CodeMeta's publisher is an Organization or Person, so a bare publisher is an object and its name is the publisher's name; a string, which is also legal, is read as the name.
- `resourceType` (no term): no crosswalk cell → `@type`. CodeMeta has no term for the resource type; a CodeMeta document states its resource type in @type.

### dcat-3

- `version` (scope): crosswalk cell `dcat:version` → `dcat:version | owl:versionInfo`. The cell says dcat:version, which DCAT 3 added for the version name or identifier of a resource; owl:versionInfo comes after it, which Zenodo's DCAT export writes.
- `author.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:creator[].foaf:givenName`. No cell; the spec types a creator as foaf:Agent, whose person form carries foaf:givenName.
- `author.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:creator[].foaf:familyName`. No cell; the spec types a creator as foaf:Agent, whose person form carries foaf:familyName.
- `author.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcterms:identifier` → `dcterms:creator[].@id`. The cell says dcterms:identifier, which names the identifier of a resource and not of an agent; an ORCID is the agent's own IRI, so the @id of the creator node.
- `contributor.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:contributor[].foaf:givenName`. Same reasoning as author.givenName, under contributor.
- `contributor.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:contributor[].foaf:familyName`. Same reasoning as author.familyName, under contributor.
- `contributor.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcterms:identifier` → `dcterms:contributor[].@id`. Same reasoning as author.@id, under contributor.
- `license` (scope): crosswalk cell `dcterms:license` → `dcterms:license | dcat:distribution[].dcterms:license`. The cell says dcterms:license, which DCAT allows on the dataset and on each distribution; the path reads the dataset's, else a distribution's.
- `swhid` (scope): crosswalk cell `dcterms:identifier` → no path. The cell says dcterms:identifier, which holds the DOI; DCAT has no property of its own for a SWHID.
- `codeRepository` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcat:accessURL` → no path. The cell says dcat:accessURL, a property of dcat:Distribution that usually points at a landing page or a download, not a repository.
- `publisher` (scope): crosswalk cell `dcterms:publisher` → `dcterms:publisher.foaf:name | dcterms:publisher`. The cell says dcterms:publisher, whose value is an agent (usually a foaf:Agent), so its name is foaf:name; an IRI value has no name sub-field.
- `resourceType` (no term): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:type`. CodeMeta has no term for the resource type; DCAT states a dataset's kind with dcterms:type; the node's own @type is dcat:Dataset.

- `contributor.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `doap:helper[].foaf:name`. No cell; DOAP people are foaf:Person nodes and the name most DOAP files give is foaf:name, one string.
- `contributor.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `doap:helper[].foaf:name`. No cell; DOAP people are foaf:Person nodes and the name most DOAP files give is foaf:name, one string.
- `contributor.@id` (added): no crosswalk cell → `doap:helper[].@id`. No cell; DOAP has no ORCID property, but a foaf:Person node can be named by its ORCID IRI, which JSON-LD keeps as @id.
- `license` (notation): crosswalk cell `license` → `doap:license`. The cell says license, DOAP's doap:license; the path names it with its prefix.
- `identifier` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty and DOAP has no property for a DOI or other persistent identifier of a project.
- `swhid` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty and DOAP has no property for a SWHID or other persistent identifier.
- `codeRepository` (notation): crosswalk cell `repository/location` → `doap:repository[].doap:location`. The cell says repository/location in XPath form; in the compacted JSON-LD tree the repository node's location is repository[].location (the node's type, GitRepository or SVNRepository, is @type).
- `description` (notation): crosswalk cell `description` → `doap:description`. The cell says description, DOAP's doap:description; the path names it with its prefix.
- `keywords` (notation): crosswalk cell `category` → `doap:category`. The cell says category, DOAP's doap:category; the path names it with its prefix.
- `datePublished` (added): no crosswalk cell → `doap:release[].doap:created`. The cell is empty; a release's date is doap:created on its doap:Version node, so the path is release[].created.
- `publisher` (notation): crosswalk cell `vendor` → `doap:vendor.foaf:name | doap:vendor`. The cell says vendor, DOAP's doap:vendor, whose value is an organisation node; its name is foaf:name, and the path names both keys with their prefix.
- `resourceType` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. CodeMeta has no term for the resource type; doap has no field for it.

### wikidata

- `name` (added): no crosswalk cell → `labels.en.value`. The cell is empty; a Wikidata item has no name property; its name is its label, one per language under labels.
- `version` (added): no crosswalk cell → `claims.P348[].mainsnak.datavalue.value`. The cell is empty; software version identifier (P348) holds the version, one statement per release.
- `author` (notation): crosswalk cell `P50` → `claims.P50[] | claims.P178[]`. The cell says P50, which is not a key of the entity JSON: statements sit under claims, and each statement is a list entry; software items mostly use P178 (developer) instead, so it is the fallback.
- `author.givenName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P735` → no path. The cell says P735, but P735 sits on the person's item and holds an item of a given name; this record holds only the person's Q id.
- `author.familyName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P734` → no path. The cell says P734, but P734 sits on the person's item and holds an item of a family name; this record holds only the person's Q id.
- `author.@id` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; the ORCID (P496) sits on the person's item, not on this one.
- `contributor` (notation): crosswalk cell `P767` → `claims.P767[]`. The cell says P767, which is not a key of the entity JSON: statements sit under claims, and each statement is a list entry.
- `contributor.givenName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P735` → no path. The cell says P735, but P735 sits on the person's item; this record holds only the person's Q id.
- `contributor.familyName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `P734` → no path. The cell says P734, but P734 sits on the person's item; this record holds only the person's Q id.
- `contributor.@id` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; the ORCID (P496) sits on the person's item, not on this one.
- `license` (notation): crosswalk cell `P275` → `claims.P275[].mainsnak.datavalue.value.id`. The cell says P275, which is not a key of the entity JSON; the licence is an item, so its Q id is the value.
- `identifier` (added): no crosswalk cell → `claims.P356[].mainsnak.datavalue.value`. The cell is empty; DOI (P356) holds a DOI.
- `swhid` (added): no crosswalk cell → `claims.P6138[].mainsnak.datavalue.value`. The cell is empty; Software Hash Identifier, SWHID (P6138), holds the Software Heritage id.
- `codeRepository` (notation): crosswalk cell `P1324` → `claims.P1324[].mainsnak.datavalue.value`. The cell says P1324, which is not a key of the entity JSON; source code repository URL is a url statement.
- `description` (added): no crosswalk cell → `descriptions.en.value`. The cell is empty; a Wikidata item has a short description per language under descriptions.
- `keywords` (notation): crosswalk cell `P921` → `claims.P921[].mainsnak.datavalue.value.id`. The cell says P921, which is not a key of the entity JSON; main subject holds items, so the value is a Q id.
- `datePublished` (notation): crosswalk cell `P577` → `claims.P577[].mainsnak.datavalue.value.time`. The cell says P577, which is not a key of the entity JSON; the date is the time field of a time value.
- `publisher` (notation): crosswalk cell `P123` → `claims.P123[].mainsnak.datavalue.value.id`. The cell says P123, which is not a key of the entity JSON; publisher holds items, so the value is the id of the item under the statement's main snak.
- `resourceType` (no term): no crosswalk cell → `claims.P31[].mainsnak.datavalue.value.id`. CodeMeta has no term for the resource type; a Wikidata item states its kind with instance of (P31), whose value is an item id.

No Croissant crosswalk upstream; Croissant 1.1, `https://docs.mlcommons.org/croissant/docs/croissant-spec-1.1.html`, describes the dataset in the document's top object, an sc:Dataset; Croissant does not define identifier, so it is schema.org's, a string or a PropertyValue, read as for RO-Crate.
- `swhid` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No Croissant crosswalk upstream; Croissant 1.1, `https://docs.mlcommons.org/croissant/docs/croissant-spec-1.1.html`, describes the dataset in the document's top object, an sc:Dataset; identifier holds the DOI; Croissant has no property of its own for a SWHID.
- `codeRepository` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No Croissant crosswalk upstream; Croissant 1.1, `https://docs.mlcommons.org/croissant/docs/croissant-spec-1.1.html`, describes the dataset in the document's top object, an sc:Dataset; the document is a Dataset, and codeRepository is a property of SoftwareSourceCode, not of Dataset.
- `description` (added): no crosswalk cell → `description`. No Croissant crosswalk upstream; Croissant 1.1, `https://docs.mlcommons.org/croissant/docs/croissant-spec-1.1.html`, describes the dataset in the document's top object, an sc:Dataset; description is required.
- `keywords` (added): no crosswalk cell → `keywords`. No Croissant crosswalk upstream; Croissant 1.1, `https://docs.mlcommons.org/croissant/docs/croissant-spec-1.1.html`, describes the dataset in the document's top object, an sc:Dataset; keywords is schema.org's.
- `datePublished` (added): no crosswalk cell → `datePublished`. No Croissant crosswalk upstream; Croissant 1.1, `https://docs.mlcommons.org/croissant/docs/croissant-spec-1.1.html`, describes the dataset in the document's top object, an sc:Dataset; datePublished is required.
- `publisher` (added): no crosswalk cell → `publisher[].name | publisher[]`. No Croissant crosswalk upstream; Croissant 1.1, `https://docs.mlcommons.org/croissant/docs/croissant-spec-1.1.html`, describes the dataset in the document's top object, an sc:Dataset; publisher is schema.org's, an Organization or Person, whose name is name; publisher may repeat.
- `resourceType` (no term): no crosswalk cell → `@type`. No Croissant crosswalk upstream; Croissant 1.1, `https://docs.mlcommons.org/croissant/docs/croissant-spec-1.1.html`, describes the dataset in the document's top object, an sc:Dataset; CodeMeta has no term for the resource type; the top object's @type is sc:Dataset.

### dublin-core

- `name` (notation): crosswalk cell `title` → `dcterms:title | dc:title[]`. The cell says title, right as written; Title is dcterms:title (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#title`, section 2) and dc:title in oai_dc (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#elements11-title`, section 3), so the path reads both with their prefix.
- `version` (corrected): crosswalk cell `dcterms:hasVersion` → no path. The cell says dcterms:hasVersion, which is wrong: it is a related resource that is a version of this one and 'is intended to be used with non-literal values' (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#hasVersion`, section 2); DCMI Terms have no property for a version string.
- `author` (notation): crosswalk cell `creator` → `dcterms:creator[] | dc:creator[]`. The cell says creator, right as written; Creator is dcterms:creator, range includes dcterms:Agent (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#creator`), and dc:creator in oai_dc, a name string (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#elements11-creator`).
- `author.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:creator[].foaf:givenName | dc:creator[]`. The cell is empty; DCMI Terms define no name parts for dcterms:Agent (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#Agent`, section 6), so a dcterms agent node's given name is foaf:givenName and an oai_dc creator is the whole name string.
- `author.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:creator[].foaf:familyName | dc:creator[]`. The cell is empty; DCMI Terms define no name parts for dcterms:Agent (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#Agent`, section 6), so a dcterms agent node's family name is foaf:familyName and an oai_dc creator is the whole name string.
- `author.@id` (added): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:creator[].@id | dc:creator[].@id`. The cell is empty; DCMI has no ORCID property, but recommends identifying the creator with a URI (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#creator`), which JSON-LD keeps as the agent node's @id.
- `contributor` (added): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:contributor[] | dc:contributor[]`. The cell is empty, but Contributor is dcterms:contributor, range includes dcterms:Agent (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#contributor`), and dc:contributor in oai_dc (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#elements11-contributor`).
- `contributor.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:contributor[].foaf:givenName | dc:contributor[]`. Same reasoning as author.givenName, under contributor.
- `contributor.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:contributor[].foaf:familyName | dc:contributor[]`. Same reasoning as author.familyName, under contributor.
- `contributor.@id` (added): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:contributor[].@id | dc:contributor[].@id`. Same reasoning as author.@id, under contributor.
- `license` (notation): crosswalk cell `license` → `dcterms:license | dcterms:rights | dc:rights[]`. The cell says license, right as written for dcterms:license (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#license`, section 2); oai_dc has no license element, so the path falls back to Rights, of which License is a subproperty (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#rights`, `https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#elements11-rights`).
- `identifier` (notation): crosswalk cell `identifier` → `dcterms:identifier | dc:identifier[]`. The cell says identifier, right as written; Identifier is dcterms:identifier, whose comment names the DOI and says persistent identifiers should be HTTP URIs (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#identifier`), and dc:identifier in oai_dc (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#elements11-identifier`).
- `swhid` (scope): crosswalk cell `identifier` → no path. The cell says identifier, which holds the DOI; DCMI Terms have no property of their own for a SWHID (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/`, section 2).
- `codeRepository` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty and DCMI Terms have no repository property; dcterms:relation is any related resource (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#relation`) and dcterms:source the resource this one is derived from (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#source`).
- `description` (notation): crosswalk cell `description` → `dcterms:description | dc:description[]`. The cell says description, right as written; Description is dcterms:description (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#description`) and dc:description in oai_dc (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#elements11-description`).
- `keywords` (added): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:subject | dc:subject[]`. The cell is empty, but Subject is the topic of the resource, 'typically represented using keywords' (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#elements11-subject`), as dcterms:subject (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#subject`) and dc:subject.
- `datePublished` (corrected): crosswalk cell `date` → `dcterms:issued | dcterms:date | dc:date[]`. The cell says date, 'A point or period of time associated with an event in the lifecycle of the resource' (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#date`), so a date may be a creation or modification date as well; dcterms:issued is the 'Date of formal issuance of the resource' (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#issued`), so the path reads it first and falls back to date, the only date oai_dc has.
- `publisher` (notation): crosswalk cell `publisher` → `dcterms:publisher.foaf:name | dcterms:publisher | dc:publisher[]`. The cell says publisher, right as written; dcterms:publisher's range includes dcterms:Agent (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#publisher`), so a node's name is foaf:name, and dc:publisher in oai_dc is a name string (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#elements11-publisher`).
- `resourceType` (no term): no crosswalk cell → `dcterms:type | dc:type[]`. CodeMeta has no term for the resource type; Type is dcterms:type and dc:type, with the DCMI Type Vocabulary recommended (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#type`, `https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#elements11-type`), whose Software class is dctype:Software (`https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#Software`, section 7).

### debian

- `name` (added): no crosswalk cell → `copyright.Upstream-Name | control.Source`. The cell is empty; copyright-format 1.0 section 6.2 (`https://www.debian.org/doc/packaging-manuals/copyright-format/1.0/`) makes Upstream-Name "the name upstream uses for the software", optional; Policy 5.6.1 Source is the Debian source package name, lower case only, and mandatory.
- `version` (corrected): crosswalk cell `numeric_version` → `changelog.Version`. The cell says numeric_version, which is no Debian field; debian/control has no Version (Policy 5.2), and the version comes from the newest debian/changelog entry (Policy 4.4, `https://www.debian.org/doc/debian-policy/ch-source.html`), as dpkg-parsechangelog prints it.
- `author` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty; no Debian field names the authors: Maintainer and Uploaders are the Debian package's maintainers (Policy 5.6.2, 5.6.3, `https://www.debian.org/doc/debian-policy/ch-controlfields.html`), Copyright holds copyright statements (copyright-format 6.8) and Upstream-Contact is an address to reach the project (6.3).
- `author.givenName` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty, and no author path to extend.
- `author.familyName` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty, and no author path to extend.
- `author.@id` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty, and no author path to extend.
- `contributor` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty; Uploaders lists the co-maintainers of the Debian package (Policy 5.6.3), who are not contributors to the software.
- `contributor.givenName` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty, and no contributor path to extend.
- `contributor.familyName` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty, and no contributor path to extend.
- `contributor.@id` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty, and no contributor path to extend.
- `license` (added): no crosswalk cell → `copyright.License`. The cell is empty; in the debian/copyright header stanza License gives "the license information for the package as a whole" (copyright-format 1.0 section 6.7).
- `identifier` (scope): crosswalk cell `Package` → no path. The cell says Package, the binary package name (Policy 5.6.7); Debian has no DOI field, and DEP-12's Reference DOI is the DOI of a publication about the work, not of the software.
- `swhid` (scope): crosswalk cell `Package` → no path. The cell says Package, the binary package name (Policy 5.6.7); Debian has no SWHID field.
- `codeRepository` (corrected): crosswalk cell `HomePage` → `upstream.Repository | control.Homepage`. The cell says HomePage; Policy 5.6.23 spells it Homepage, 'The URL of the web site for this package, preferably (when applicable) the site from which the original source can be obtained' (`https://www.debian.org/doc/debian-policy/ch-controlfields.html`), a web site and not a repository, so it is the fallback after DEP-12's Repository, 'URL to a repository containing the upstream sources' (`https://dep-team.pages.debian.net/deps/dep12/`).
- `description` (notation): crosswalk cell `Description` → `packages[].Description`. The cell says Description; Description sits in each binary package stanza of debian/control, not the source stanza (Policy 5.2, 5.6.13).
- `keywords` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty; the only candidate, Section, is one archive section such as science or python (Policy 5.6.5), not a keyword list.
- `datePublished` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty; the changelog Date is when the Debian package was "built or last edited" (Policy 5.6.15), not when the software was published.
- `publisher` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty; debian has no publisher field.
- `resourceType` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. CodeMeta has no term for the resource type; debian has no field for it (Package-Type, Policy 5.6.28, is deb or udeb).

### mods

- `name` (notation): crosswalk cell `titleInfo/title` → `titleInfo[].title[]`. The cell says titleInfo/title, an XPath; in the path grammar it is the title inside each titleInfo (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, titleInfo, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/titleinfo.html`).
- `version` (notation): crosswalk cell `originInfo/edition` → `originInfo[].edition[]`. The cell says originInfo/edition, an XPath; edition is "information identifying the version of the resource" (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, originInfo, edition, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/origininfo.html`).
- `author` (notation): crosswalk cell `name/role/roleTerm[@type='code']/[.='aut']` → `name[roleTerm=aut]`. The cell says name/role/roleTerm[@type='code']/[.='aut'], an XPath: a name whose MARC relator code is aut (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, name, role, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/name.html`; relator codes, `https://www.loc.gov/marc/relators/relacode.html`).
- `author.givenName` (notation): crosswalk cell `name/namePart[@type='given']` → `name[roleTerm=aut].namePart[@type=given]`. The cell says name/namePart[@type='given'], an XPath: the namePart typed given (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, name, namePart, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/name.html`).
- `author.familyName` (notation): crosswalk cell `name/namePart[@type='family']` → `name[roleTerm=aut].namePart[@type=family]`. The cell says name/namePart[@type='family'], an XPath: the namePart typed family (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, name, namePart, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/name.html`).
- `author.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identifier / name/nameIdentifier` → `name[roleTerm=aut].nameIdentifier[@type=orcid]`. The cell lists identifier / name/nameIdentifier; identifier is the record's own identifier, not a person's, and nameIdentifier holds every kind of name identifier, so the ORCID is the one typed orcid, a code in LC's Standard Identifier Source Codes (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, name, nameIdentifier, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/name.html`; `https://www.loc.gov/standards/sourcelist/standard-identifier.html`).
- `contributor` (notation): crosswalk cell `name/role/roleTerm[@type='code']/[.='ctb']` → `name[roleTerm=ctb]`. The cell says name/role/roleTerm[@type='code']/[.='ctb'], an XPath: a name whose MARC relator code is ctb (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, name, role, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/name.html`; relator codes, `https://www.loc.gov/marc/relators/relacode.html`).
- `contributor.givenName` (notation): crosswalk cell `name/namePart[@type='given']` → `name[roleTerm=ctb].namePart[@type=given]`. Same reasoning as author.givenName, under contributor.
- `contributor.familyName` (notation): crosswalk cell `name/namePart[@type='family']` → `name[roleTerm=ctb].namePart[@type=family]`. Same reasoning as author.familyName, under contributor.
- `contributor.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identifier / name/nameIdentifier` → `name[roleTerm=ctb].nameIdentifier[@type=orcid]`. Same reasoning as author.@id, under contributor.
- `license` (notation): crosswalk cell `accessCondition[@type='use and reproduction']` → `accessCondition[]`. The cell says accessCondition[@type='use and reproduction'], the right element in XPath: accessCondition holds rights statements, and the type use and reproduction marks a licence (`https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/accesscondition.html`); a filter value cannot hold a space, so the path reads every accessCondition.
- `identifier` (scope): crosswalk cell `identifier` → `identifier[@type=doi]`. The cell says identifier, which holds every kind of identifier (ISBN, handle, URI and more); the DOI is the one typed doi (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, identifier, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/identifier.html`).
- `swhid` (scope): crosswalk cell `identifier` → no path. The cell says identifier, which holds the DOI; LC's Standard Identifier Source Codes, the suggested values for its type, have no code for a SWHID (`https://www.loc.gov/standards/sourcelist/standard-identifier.html`).
- `codeRepository` (corrected): crosswalk cell `location/url[@access='object in context']` → no path. The cell says location/url[@access='object in context'], which the guidelines define as a link to the object within its environment, such as a landing page, not a source repository (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, location, url, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/location.html`); MODS has no repository field, and a filter value cannot hold the spaces anyway.
- `description` (notation): crosswalk cell `abstract` → `abstract[]`. The cell says abstract, the right element; abstract is repeatable, so the path reads each one (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, abstract, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/abstract.html`).
- `keywords` (corrected): crosswalk cell `subject` → `subject[].topic[]`. The cell says subject, a container that also holds geographic, temporal, name and other subjects; a keyword is a topic inside it (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, subject, topic, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/subject.html`).
- `datePublished` (notation): crosswalk cell `originInfo/dateIssued` → `originInfo[].dateIssued[]`. The cell says originInfo/dateIssued, an XPath; dateIssued is "the date that the resource was published, released, or issued" (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, originInfo, dateIssued, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/origininfo.html`).
- `publisher` (notation): crosswalk cell `originInfo/publisher` → `originInfo[].publisher[]`. The cell says originInfo/publisher, an XPath; publisher names the entity that published or issued the resource (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, originInfo, publisher, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/origininfo.html`).
- `resourceType` (no term): no crosswalk cell → `typeOfResource[]`. CodeMeta has no term for the resource type; MODS states it in typeOfResource (MODS 3.8 Guidelines, typeOfResource, `https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/userguide/typeofresource.html`).

### vivo-1.8

- `name` (notation): crosswalk cell `label` → `rdfs:label`. The cell says label, which the crosswalk's first commit, `https://github.com/codemeta/codemeta/commit/16f496a`, gave as rdfs:label; the path names it with its prefix.
- `version` (notation): crosswalk cell `version` → `obo:ERO_0000072`. The cell says version, the rdfs:label of obo:ERO_0000072 in VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, a string property whose domain is Software (obo:ERO_0000071) or Database; the path names it by its IRI.
- `author` (corrected): crosswalk cell `relatedBy.relates` → `vivo:relatedBy[@type=Authorship].vivo:relates[]`. The cell says relatedBy.relates, which also reaches editorships and the work itself; VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, links a work to its authors through a vivo:Authorship node that vivo:relates both the work and an agent, so the path keeps only Authorship nodes.
- `author.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `vivo:relatedBy[@type=Authorship].vivo:relates[].obo:ARG_2000028[].vcard:hasName.vcard:givenName + vivo:relatedBy[@type=Authorship].vivo:relates[].vcard:hasName.vcard:givenName`. The cell is empty; VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, gives vcard:givenName the domain vcard:Name; a foaf:Person reaches its vcard:Individual through obo:ARG_2000028 (has contact info), and an author with no profile is a vcard:Individual itself, as VIVO 1.16.0's AddAuthorsToInformationResourceGenerator writes them.
- `author.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `vivo:relatedBy[@type=Authorship].vivo:relates[].obo:ARG_2000028[].vcard:hasName.vcard:familyName + vivo:relatedBy[@type=Authorship].vivo:relates[].vcard:hasName.vcard:familyName`. The cell is empty; same as author.givenName, with vcard:familyName, which VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, also puts on vcard:Name.
- `author.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `relatedBy.relates.ORCID iD` → `vivo:relatedBy[@type=Authorship].vivo:relates[].vivo:orcidId[].@id`. The cell says relatedBy.relates.ORCID iD, the label of vivo:orcidId, and the crosswalk's first commit gave its range as a string; VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, makes vivo:orcidId an object property on foaf:Person whose value is the ORCID IRI, so the path reads its @id.
- `contributor` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty; VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, links people to a work only as authors (vivo:Authorship) or editors (vivo:Editorship) and declares dcterms:contributor only as the parent of bibo:performer and bibo:translator; vivo:contributingRole links a role (BFO_0000023), not a person, to a work.
- `contributor.givenName` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty and VIVO has no contributor, see contributor.
- `contributor.familyName` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty and VIVO has no contributor, see contributor.
- `contributor.@id` (no field): crosswalk cell `relatedBy.relates.ORCID iD` → no path. The cell repeats author's ORCID path, because the crosswalk has one Person identifier row; VIVO has no contributor, see contributor.
- `license` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty and VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, has no licence property for a work; its vivo:License class is an official permission held as a credential, not a software licence.
- `identifier` (scope): crosswalk cell `SWHID` → `bibo:doi`. The cell says SWHID, which is vivo:swhid and belongs to the swhid row; the DOI is bibo:doi, a sub-property of bibo:identifier with no domain in VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`.
- `swhid` (notation): crosswalk cell `SWHID` → `vivo:swhid`. The cell says SWHID, the rdfs:label of vivo:swhid, which the crosswalk's first commit, `https://github.com/codemeta/codemeta/commit/16f496a`, named; VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, adds it as a sub-property of vivo:identifier with the domain Software (obo:ERO_0000071); the path names it with its prefix.
- `codeRepository` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty and VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, has no repository property; its web links (obo:ARG_2000028 to vcard:hasURL), which the crosswalk gives for url, carry no kind.
- `description` (notation): crosswalk cell `abstract` → `bibo:abstract`. The cell says abstract, which the crosswalk's first commit gave as bibo:abstract; VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, gives it the domain obo:IAO_0000030 (information content entity), Software's superclass; the path names it with its prefix.
- `keywords` (corrected): crosswalk cell `freetextKeywords` → `vivo:freetextKeyword`. The cell says freetextKeywords; the property in VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, is vivo:freetextKeyword, singular, one keyword or phrase per statement.
- `datePublished` (corrected): crosswalk cell `date/time value` → `vivo:dateTimeValue.vivo:dateTime`. The cell says date/time value, the label of vivo:dateTimeValue, whose value in VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, is a vivo:DateTimeValue node, not a date; the date is that node's vivo:dateTime.
- `publisher` (added): no crosswalk cell → `vivo:publisher.rdfs:label | vivo:publisher`. The cell is empty; VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, has vivo:publisher with the range foaf:Organization and no domain, and VIVO 1.16.0's AddPublicationToPersonGenerator names the publisher with rdfs:label.
- `resourceType` (no term): no crosswalk cell → `@type`. CodeMeta has no term for the resource type; VIVO states it in the node's rdf:type, and VIVO 1.8.0 vivo.owl, `https://github.com/vivo-ontologies/vivo-ontology/blob/vivo-ontology-1.8.0/vivo.owl`, types software as obo:ERO_0000071.

### spase-2.6.1

- `name` (notation): crosswalk cell `ResourceHeader/ResourceName` → `ResourceHeader.ResourceName`. The cell says ResourceHeader/ResourceName, right as written with / for the element path; ResourceName is the resource's short name (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#ResourceName`).
- `version` (added): no crosswalk cell → `SoftwareVersion`. The cell is empty; the crosswalk maps softwareVersion to SoftwareVersion, a child of Software that describes the edition of the release (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#Software_SoftwareVersion`).
- `author` (added): no crosswalk cell → `ResourceHeader.PublicationInfo.Authors`. The cell is empty; PublicationInfo.Authors names who made the resource, as one string (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#Authors`).
- `author.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `ResourceHeader.PublicationInfo.Authors`. The cell is empty; Authors keeps every name in one string, a person written last, first [, middle] (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#Authors`).
- `author.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `ResourceHeader.PublicationInfo.Authors`. The cell is empty; Authors keeps every name in one string, a person written last, first [, middle] (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#Authors`).
- `author.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `ResourceHeader/DOI` → no path. The cell says ResourceHeader/DOI, which is the resource's DOI, not a person's id; Authors is plain text, and an ORCID sits only in a separate Person record's ORCIdentifier (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#Person`).
- `contributor` (added): no crosswalk cell → `ResourceHeader.Contact[Role=Contributor]`. The cell is empty; a Contact names a person and the roles they hold, and the Role list has Contributor (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#Contact`).
- `contributor.givenName` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty; a Contact holds only PersonID, and PersonName sits in the separate Person record, which a path cannot follow (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#Person`).
- `contributor.familyName` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty; a Contact holds only PersonID, and PersonName sits in the separate Person record, which a path cannot follow (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#Person`).
- `contributor.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `ResourceHeader/DOI` → no path. The cell says ResourceHeader/DOI, which is the resource's DOI, not a person's id; a Contact's PersonID is a SPASE registry id, and the ORCID sits in the separate Person record's ORCIdentifier (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#Person`).
- `license` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty; 2.6.1 has no licence element, and AccessRights (Open, PartiallyRestricted, Restricted) says who may access the resource, not under which licence (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#AccessRights`).
- `identifier` (scope): crosswalk cell `ResourceID` → `ResourceHeader.DOI`. The cell says ResourceID, the spase:// URI that names the record in the SPASE registry, not a DOI; the DOI is ResourceHeader.DOI, which the crosswalk puts on the Person identifier row (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#DOI`).
- `swhid` (scope): crosswalk cell `ResourceID` → no path. The cell says ResourceID, a spase:// URI of the SPASE registry, not a Software Heritage id; SPASE has no place for one (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#ResourceID`).
- `codeRepository` (corrected): crosswalk cell `AccessInformation/RepositoryID` → `AccessInformation[].AccessURL[Style=Git].URL`. The cell says AccessInformation/RepositoryID, which is the ResourceID of a SPASE Repository record (spase://NASA/Repository/NASA-GitHub), not a URL; the link is an AccessURL, and Style Git marks a Git one (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#Style`).
- `description` (notation): crosswalk cell `ResourceHeader/Description` → `ResourceHeader.Description`. The cell says ResourceHeader/Description, right as written with / for the element path (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#ResourceHeader`).
- `keywords` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty; Software has no Keyword element, which 2.6.1 gives only to Catalog, data and model-run resources and Document (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#Software`).
- `datePublished` (corrected): crosswalk cell `ResourceHeader/ReleaseDate` → `ResourceHeader.PublicationInfo.PublicationDate`. The cell says ResourceHeader/ReleaseDate, which the spec says should be the date the resource description was published; PublicationInfo.PublicationDate is the date the work was first issued (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#PublicationDate`).
- `publisher` (added): no crosswalk cell → `ResourceHeader.PublicationInfo.PublishedBy`. The cell is empty; PublishedBy names the organization or person that issues the work (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#PublishedBy`).
- `resourceType` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. CodeMeta has no term for the resource type; SPASE 2.6.1 states it in the resource element's name (Software under Spase), which a path cannot reach (SPASE 2.6.1, `https://spase-group.org/data/model/spase-2.6.1/spase-2_6_1_xsd.htm#Software`).

### iso-19115-1-2014

- `author` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role='author'].party.name or identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role='originator'].party.name` → `identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=author].party[] + identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=coAuthor].party[] | identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=originator].party[]`. The cell reads party.name, a string, quotes the filter values and joins with 'or'; the author is each party (1..*) of a CI_Responsibility whose role is author, else originator (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/cit/2.0/citation.xsd`, CI_Responsibility_Type). coAuthor, 'party who jointly authors the resource', is added beside author (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/resources/codelists/cit-2.0-codelists.xml#CI_RoleCode`).
- `author.givenName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `party.name*` → `identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=author].party[].name + identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=coAuthor].party[].name | identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=originator].party[].name`. The cell says party.name, relative to the party: a party has one name string (0..1) and no given or family name apart (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/cit/2.0/citation.xsd`, AbstractCI_Party_Type).
- `author.familyName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `party.name*` → `identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=author].party[].name + identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=coAuthor].party[].name | identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=originator].party[].name`. The cell says party.name, relative to the party: a party has one name string (0..1) and no given or family name apart (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/cit/2.0/citation.xsd`, AbstractCI_Party_Type).
- `author.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identificationInfo.citation.identifier.code` → `identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=author].party[].partyIdentifier[].code + identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=coAuthor].party[].partyIdentifier[].code | identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=originator].party[].partyIdentifier[].code`. The cell says identificationInfo.citation.identifier.code, the resource's own identifier, not a person's; Habermann's source table gives party.partyIdentifier.code (`https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.7430282.v1`). partyIdentifier (0..*), 'value uniquely identifying a party', came with Amd 1:2018 (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/cit/2.0/citation.xsd`, AbstractCI_Party_Type).
- `contributor` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[not(role='author' or role='principalInvestigator' or role='originator')].party.name*` → `identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=contributor].party[] + identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=collaborator].party[]`. The cell takes every role but author, principalInvestigator and originator, which the grammar cannot negate and which also takes publisher, funder and pointOfContact; the 2014 role codes have contributor, 'party contributing to the resource', and collaborator, 'party who assists with the generation of the resource other than the principal investigator' (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/resources/codelists/cit-2.0-codelists.xml#CI_RoleCode`).
- `contributor.givenName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `party.name*` → `identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=contributor].party[].name + identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=collaborator].party[].name`. Same reasoning as author.givenName, under contributor.
- `contributor.familyName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `party.name*` → `identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=contributor].party[].name + identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=collaborator].party[].name`. Same reasoning as author.familyName, under contributor.
- `contributor.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identificationInfo.citation.identifier.code` → `identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=contributor].party[].partyIdentifier[].code + identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=collaborator].party[].partyIdentifier[].code`. Same reasoning as author.@id, under contributor.
- `license` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identificationInfo.resourceConstraints.reference` → `identificationInfo.resourceConstraints[].reference[].onlineResource[].linkage | identificationInfo.resourceConstraints[].reference[].title`. The cell names reference, a CI_Citation object 'for the limitation or constraint, e.g. copyright statement, license agreement' (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/mco/1.0/constraints.xsd`, MD_Constraints_Type); the licence is that citation's link, else its title (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/cit/2.0/citation.xsd`, CI_OnlineResource_Type.linkage).
- `identifier` (notation): crosswalk cell `identificationInfo.citation.identifier.code` → `identificationInfo.citation.identifier[].code`. The cell names identifier.code, but identifier repeats (0..*), so it is a list (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/cit/2.0/citation.xsd`, CI_Citation_Type; `https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/mcc/1.0/commonClasses.xsd`, MD_Identifier_Type).
- `swhid` (scope): crosswalk cell `identificationInfo.citation.identifier.code` → no path. The cell says identifier.code, which holds the DOI; ISO 19115-1 has no property or codeSpace of its own for a SWHID (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/mcc/1.0/commonClasses.xsd`, MD_Identifier_Type).
- `codeRepository` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. The cell is empty; CI_OnlineResource.function has no value for a source repository (download, information, offlineAccess, order, search, completeMetadata, browseGraphic, upload, emailService, browsing, fileAccess; `https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/cit/2.0/citation.xsd`). Habermann's source table maps it to distribution download or information links (`https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.7430282.v1`), which are not the repository.
- `keywords` (notation): crosswalk cell `identificationInfo.descriptiveKeywords[type='theme'].keyword*` → `identificationInfo.descriptiveKeywords[type=theme].keyword[]`. The cell quotes the filter value and keyword repeats (1..*) inside each MD_Keywords (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/mri/1.0/identification.xsd`, MD_Keywords_Type).
- `datePublished` (notation): crosswalk cell `identificationInfo.citation.date[dateType='publication'].date*` → `identificationInfo.citation.date[dateType=publication].date`. The cell quotes the filter value and date repeats (0..*); the publication date is the CI_Date whose dateType is publication, 'date identifies when the resource was issued' (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/cit/2.0/citation.xsd`, CI_Date_Type).
- `publisher` (notation): crosswalk cell `identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role='publisher'].party.name*` → `identificationInfo.citation.citedResponsibleParty[role=publisher].party[].name`. The cell quotes the filter value, and party repeats (1..*) under each CI_Responsibility (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/cit/2.0/citation.xsd`, CI_Responsibility_Type; role publisher, `https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/resources/codelists/cit-2.0-codelists.xml#CI_RoleCode`).
- `resourceType` (no term): no crosswalk cell → `metadataScope[].resourceScope`. CodeMeta has no term for the resource type; MD_Metadata.metadataScope (0..*) gives the resourceScope, an MD_ScopeCode (`https://schemas.isotc211.org/19115/-3/mdb/2.0/metadataBase.xsd`, MD_MetadataScope_Type).

## Not reviewed

CodeMeta has 10 more crosswalks with no reviewed mapping.

| Mark | Shape | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| • | path | the cell looks like one path; nobody has checked it |
| ¶ | prose | the cell is prose or a list, not one path |
| ○ | empty | the cell is empty: the format may have no field, or the crosswalk leaves it out |
| ∅ | no-term | CodeMeta's property table has no row for this term |
| ? | unmatched | the crosswalk and the property table list this property a different number of times |

Why each is not reviewed:

- ASCL (registry): the Astrophysics Source Code Library's entry fields, a registry record. <https://ascl.net/>
- codemeta-V1 (superseded): CodeMeta 1.0; the reviewed codemeta and codemeta-2 rows read the contexts that replaced it. <https://codemeta.github.io/terms/>
- csdms (registry): the model-description fields of the CSDMS model repository, a catalogue of earth-surface models. <https://csdms.colorado.edu/wiki/Model_download_portal>
- DCAT-2 (superseded): DCAT 2, which DCAT 3 replaced as the W3C Recommendation in 2024; the reviewed dcat-3 rows read that. <https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat-3/>
- OntoSoft (registry): the ontology of the OntoSoft software registry, whose code was last changed in 2023. <https://github.com/KnowledgeCaptureAndDiscovery/ontosoft>
- SciCrunchRegistry (registry): the SciCrunch Registry's resource fields, the records behind RRIDs. <https://scicrunch.org/resources>
- Software Discovery Index (niche): the NIH BD2K software index proposed at a 2014 workshop; no index was launched. <https://web.archive.org/web/20141207053849/http://softwarediscoveryindex.org/report/>
- Software Ontology (niche): an OWL ontology that classifies software tools in knowledge bases, not a metadata file. <https://github.com/allysonlister/swo>
- Trove Software Map (niche): Trove classifiers, a category vocabulary rather than a record format; a package's classifiers are in pkg-info. <https://pypi.org/classifiers/>
- usgs-modelcatalog (registry): the record fields of the USGS model catalog. <https://data.usgs.gov/modelcatalog/>
